title: 第5章 农夫

content_zh:
“玄英，自坟里出来的可是一个农夫？”马真人问道。
“正是一个农夫！”
马真人叹息一声，说道：“罢了徒儿，如果再把这农夫杀掉，他宋家世代出的都是乞丐，唉，宋家并无大恶，这口气为师出了，得饶人处切饶人，到此为止吧。”
蒋玄英点了点头，也不废话，用黑布包裹住煞刀，随即走到坟头上捡起八卦盘。
收拾完这些，他与我师父搀扶马真人离开了宋家坟地。
跪在地上的农夫一见三人离去，顿时如蒙大赦般化为一股白烟钻入坟头消失不见。
过了一会，坟里隐隐传来一男一女的说话声，伴随着声响，两只鬼魂携手飘出，正是死去多年的宋老爷与他的夫人孙氏。
宋老爷看了看一行三人远去的背影，跪在地上磕了几个头，嘴里喃喃道：“马真人，这几年发生的事我都看在眼里，是我宋家对不住你呀。”
“老头子，那马真人的徒弟斩断咱们家运势，你还给他磕头道歉，是不是老糊涂了，不行，这仇咱们得报，我去上了那个麻衣小子身，好好教训教训他。”
孙氏一脸的怨毒之色，目光死死的盯着三人远去的方向，语气森然的说道。
宋老爷一听，身子剧烈的颤抖起来，猛的起身，“啪”得一个大嘴巴子打在了孙氏的脸上，咆哮道：“我看你是做鬼做的老糊涂了，先不说咱们宋家有愧于马真人，就他那徒弟，你以为是软柿子，谁都能捏几下？他手中拿的那把刀可是屠刀！是杀生刃！不要说一刀砍在你身上，就算刀上的煞气也够你受的，上他的身，我看你纯粹是活得不耐烦，连转世轮回都不想了！”
孙氏被宋老爷的一个耳光瞬间打清醒了，一想到麻衣青年手中煞刀的厉害，顿时吓得一激灵，她委屈的捂着脸，哭哭啼啼的说道：“那宋志咋办，他可是咱们儿子，麻衣小子斩断咱家的官运，以后宋家世代出的都是农民，最后还是苦的咱儿子啊。”
“呵呵，都是报应！因果报应啊！宋志自己种下的苦果就让他自己去尝吧，何况马真人还给宋家留下了一线生机，唉，你我夫妻二人为了守护宋家的运势，已经耽误了足足十年没去投胎，罢了！这一切就让它过去吧，儿孙自有儿孙福，管得了一时管不了一世，你我还是忘掉这一世，去走那轮回之路吧。”
孙氏一听此话，更是捂着脸伤心的痛哭了起来。
最后在宋老爷的安慰下，二人转身看了看阳间世界，脸上隐现不舍之意，眼中流露出对红尘世间美好，无限的眷恋，各自惋惜一声，携手走进了坟里。
一时间，坟地寂静无声，只有一块青色石碑，安静的屹立在那里。
时光流逝，两年过后，马真人与世长辞，我师父与蒋玄英选择一处风水宜人的地方将他好生安葬，从那以后，他们师徒二人就在后山的那处破道观长居住下，蒋玄英对待我师父特别好，如同亲生儿子一般，除了教他识字以外，闲暇时间便传授他道术。
而我师父头脑也瞥为灵活，学习道术进步很快，等到了他十五岁那年，已经可以单独出去为十里八村的乡亲做法事了。
而这一年，宋家也发生了一件了不得的大事。
一天夜里，山上下来了一群土匪，大约三十多人，骑马跨刀，杀气腾腾的直奔宋家大院而去。

当晚宋家是火光冲天，鸡飞狗跳，大柳村家家户户大门紧闭，没有一个人敢出去看热闹的，就这样，一夜之间，宋家的所有财产被抢夺一空，房屋更是被土匪一把火烧个精光。
宋志的媳妇因为有些姿色，也被土匪头子抓到山上去做了压寨夫人，从此再无音讯，宋志接受不了这个残酷的事实，当晚口吐鲜血，翻了白眼，险些就这么过去。
打那以后，宋家的日子是一天不如一天，下人走的走，逃的逃，最后就只剩下宋志和两个儿子大虎和小虎，相依为命。
时光在茬，这一转眼间，就是三十年过去，一切早已物是人非。
宋志生了一场病走了之后，宋家的家业就落在了大虎与小虎的身上，其实也没啥家业，就是几间土坯房和几亩田地，毕竟宋家的财产早已经被土匪掠夺一空了。
到了大虎与小虎这代，已经成为了地地道道的农民，与大柳村的村民一样，他们也日出而作，日落而归，大柳村宋家，从此之后不复存在，只剩下两个姓宋的普通农民。

content_en:
"Xuanying, is this a farmer who came out of the grave?" Ma Zhenren asked.
"Exactly a farmer!"
Master Ma sighed and said, "Forget it, disciple. If we kill this farmer again, all generations of his Song family will be beggars. Alas, there is no great evil in the Song family. This is the tone of the teacher. You have to be merciful and spare others. That's the end of it."
Jiang Xuanying nodded without any nonsense, wrapped the evil sword in black cloth, and then walked to the grave to pick up the Bagua plate.
After cleaning up, he and my master helped Master Ma leave the Song family cemetery.
As soon as the farmer kneeling on the ground saw the three people leaving, he suddenly turned into a puff of white smoke and disappeared into the grave, as if he had been granted amnesty.
After a while, the voices of a man and a woman were faintly heard from the tomb. Following the sound, two ghosts floated out hand in hand. It was Mr. Song and his wife, Mrs. Sun, who had been dead for many years.
Master Song looked at the retreating figures of the three people, knelt on the ground and kowtowed a few times, and murmured: "Master Ma, I have seen everything that has happened in the past few years. It is the Song family that cannot forgive you."
"Old man, when Master Ma's apprentice cut off our family's fortune, you still kowtow to him and apologize. Are you being an old fool? No, we have to avenge this. I'll go get that boy in sackcloth and teach him a lesson."
Mrs. Sun had a look of resentment on her face, staring at the direction in which the three of them were leaving, and said in a solemn tone.
When Master Song heard this, his body trembled violently, he stood up suddenly, slapped Mr. Sun on the face with a big mouth, and roared: "I think you are an old fool. Not to mention that our Song family is ashamed of Master Ma, as for his disciple, what do you think?" How many times can anyone pinch him? The knife in his hand is a killing knife! Not to mention that the evil energy on the knife is enough for you. If it hits him, I think you are simply impatient and don't even want to reincarnate!"
Mrs. Sun was instantly awakened by Master Song's slap. When she thought about the power of the sword in the hand of the young man in sackcloth, she was immediately frightened. She covered her face in grievance and cried and said: "What should we do about Song Zhi? He is our son. The boy in sackcloth has cut off our family's official fortune. From now on, the Song family will produce farmers for generations. In the end, our son will still suffer."
"Haha, it's all retribution! Karma is retribution! Let Song Zhi taste the bitter fruits he sows, not to mention that Master Ma also left a glimmer of hope for the Song family. Alas, you and I have delayed reincarnation for ten years in order to protect the fortune of the Song family, that's all! Let all this pass. Children and grandchildren will have their own blessings. You can't control it for a while. You and I should forget this life and go on the road of reincarnation."
When Sun heard this, she covered her face and cried sadly.
Finally, with the comfort of Master Song, the two of them turned around and looked at the world of the underworld, with a hint of reluctance on their faces, and their eyes showing their infinite attachment to the beauty of the mortal world. They each expressed regret and walked into the grave hand in hand.
For a moment, the cemetery was silent, with only a blue stone tablet standing there quietly.
Time passed, and two years later, Ma Zhenren passed away. My master and Jiang Xuanying chose a place with pleasant Feng Shui to bury him alive. From then on, their master and apprentice lived in the broken Taoist temple in the back mountain. Jiang Xuanying treated my master very well, as if he were his own son. In addition to teaching him how to read, he taught him Taoism in his spare time.
And my master's mind was also very flexible, and he made rapid progress in learning Taoism. When he was fifteen years old, he was able to go out alone to perform rituals for the villagers in eight villages ten miles away.
And this year, a great event also happened in the Song family.
One night, a group of bandits, about thirty people, came down the mountain. They rode horses and straddled swords, and headed straight for the Song family compound with murderous intent.
That night, the Song family was in flames, and every family in Daliu Village was in flames.The doors of every house were closed, and no one dared to go out to watch the excitement. Just like that, all the property of the Song family was robbed overnight, and the house was burned down by the bandits.
Because of her beauty, Song Zhi's daughter-in-law was also captured by the bandit leader and taken to the mountain to become his wife. She was never heard from again. Song Zhi couldn't accept this cruel fact. He vomited blood that night, rolled his eyes, and almost let it go.
From then on, the life of the Song family became worse and worse day by day. The servants ran away and fled. In the end, only Song Zhi and his two sons, Dahu and Xiaohu, were left to depend on each other.
Time is passing, and in the blink of an eye, thirty years have passed, and everything has changed.
After Song Zhi fell ill and left, the Song family's property fell on Dahu and Xiaohu. In fact, there was no family property, just a few adobe houses and a few acres of fields. After all, the Song family's property had already been plundered by bandits.
By the generation of Dahu and Xiaohu, they had become out-and-out farmers. Like the villagers of Daliusun Village, they also worked at sunrise and returned at sunset. From then on, the Song family in Daliusun Village ceased to exist, leaving only two ordinary farmers named Song.
